items.text: Data Scientist with 4 years of experience in product experimentation, causal inference, demand forecasting, and executive decision analytics using Python and SQL.

entries.heading: Data Scientist, Growth & Experimentation | Hearthstone Home | 2023 – Present

items.text: Led design and analysis of 50+ controlled online A/B experiments across checkout and onboarding flows, implementing CUPED variance reduction, sequential testing, and automated guardrail metrics.

Estimated incremental lift of regional out-of-home and connected-TV campaigns where randomized trials were infeasible using Difference-in-Differences and Bayesian synthetic control, reallocating $3.8M in marketing budget.

Wrote complex analytical SQL and Python pipelines over 12TB of event clickstream data in GCP BigQuery to uncover activation funnel bottlenecks, lifting Day-30 buyer retention by 2.4 percentage points.
Developed batch customer propensity and LTV scoring models in Python (scikit-learn, statsmodels) refreshed weekly via Cloud Composer for CRM lifecycle email targeting.
Engineered 45 reusable behavioral features and canonical experiment exposure tables in dbt on GCP BigQuery, replacing 3,000+ lines of fragile ad-hoc scheduled queries.
Projected 52-week recurring billing renewals and seasonal churn trajectories using hierarchical ARIMA and Prophet state-space models, achieving 3.1% MAPE for quarterly finance planning.
Built an internal Python power-calculation and minimum detectable effect (MDE) simulator used by 15 product managers prior to A/B test launch.
Analyzed weekly paid search ad spend elasticity and diminishing returns across channels using Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
Onboarded and guided 2 associate data scientists on quasi-experimental methodology and peer-reviewed all study pre-registrations before launch.
Partnered with retail operations on seasonal inventory allocation across 600+ physical flagship stores and pop-up locations.
Applied propensity score nearest-neighbor matching and doubly robust estimation in Python to quantify the causal impact of loyalty rewards on unexposed cohorts.
Distilled open-ended merchandising inquiries into interactive Looker views and cohort explorer workbooks adopted by 40+ category managers.
Authored quarterly executive recommendations and briefed the VP of Product and CFO on pricing tier elasticity, driving a $6.5M annual margin expansion.
Applied Benjamini-Hochberg step-up adjustments across 24-metric launch scorecards to cap family-wise false positives below 5% during multi-arm checkout rollouts.
Detected a 51.8/48.2 treatment-control traffic skew caused by iOS background push token drops via automated chi-square ingestion checks, halting 4 corrupted rollouts before readout.
Reduced Looker executive dashboard query load time from 45s to 6s via pre-aggregated BigQuery materialized views and partition pruning.
Integrated third-party weather forecast APIs to annotate regional carrier delay anomalies in historical fulfillment tables.
Trained offline gradient-boosted classification trees (LightGBM) to flag high-risk subscription pause requests for retention outreach.
Audited stratified random sampling logic in annual customer NPS email surveys to correct for demographic non-response bias.
Observed 15+ qualitative usability lab sessions alongside UX researchers to test low-fidelity prototype wireframes.
Sparked a company-wide experimentation guild with biweekly paper readings and self-serve hypothesis templates.
Passed the Torch culture award to the incoming analytics guild lead at the annual company offsite.

entries.heading: B.S. in Statistics & Economics | University of Michigan | 2017 – 2021

items.text: Minor in Behavioral Psychology (research thesis on operant conditioning and positive reinforcement schedules in consumer habit formation).
Coursework: Econometrics, Applied Regression, Time-Series Analysis, Experimental Design, Probability Theory.
Experimentation & Causal Inference: A/B Testing, CUPED, Sequential Testing, Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, Propensity Score Matching, Instrumental Variables
Modeling & Forecasting: ARIMA, Prophet, State-Space Models, Linear/Logistic Regression, LightGBM, scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyMC
Languages & BI: Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy), SQL, R, Looker, Tableau
Data Stack: GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Composer), dbt, Git, Jupyter
